info.title: OPTIX Threat Intelligence API
info.description: Versioned REST API for OPTIX. The v1 baseline mirrors the existing /api/ surface — see docs/api-changelog.md for the included endpoint inventory and deprecation policy.

tags.name: Dashboard & Stats
tags.description: Platform-level statistics and aggregate metrics, scoped to the caller's active organization

tags.name: Sources
tags.description: Manage threat intelligence feed sources — RSS feeds, API connectors (NVD, OTX, URLhaus, MalwareBazaar), web crawlers, and social media channels (Discord, Telegram, Reddit, Mastodon). All source endpoints are org-isolated: sources belong to the caller's active organization.

tags.name: Source Discovery & Pipeline
tags.description: Auto-discovered CTI sources found in document cross-references during ingestion, web search discovery, social media channel discovery, and source preview/validation. These are candidate sources awaiting analyst approval. Org-scoped: discovered sources belong to the caller's active organization.

tags.name: Source Catalog
tags.description: Curated catalog of known CTI sources with recommendations, web search for discovering new sources, and catalog-based source addition. Org-scoped: catalog additions create sources within the caller's active organization.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Ingested threat intelligence documents — the core data objects. Documents go through scoring, classification (accept/quarantine/reject), and entity extraction. All document endpoints are org-scoped: documents belong to the caller's active organization with cross-org visibility for shared documents.

tags.name: Entities
tags.description: Extracted threat intelligence entities: threat actors (APTs), malware families, CVEs/vulnerabilities, IOCs (IPs, domains, hashes, URLs, emails), MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and tools. Org-scoped: entities belong to the caller's active organization with cross-org visibility for shared entities.

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Intelligent CTI search across documents, entities, and external sources with AI-powered query expansion, enhancement, and deep multi-step research. Org-scoped: search results are filtered to the caller's active organization.

tags.name: Enrichment
tags.description: Threat enrichment from external intelligence providers — VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, Shodan, GreyNoise, URLScan, URLhaus, OTX, CrowdSec, and IP geolocation. Includes rate limiting, caching, and quota management. Org-scoped: enrichment results and cache are isolated per organization. Requires Individual plan or higher.

tags.name: Provider Keys
tags.description: Manage API keys for external enrichment providers. Keys are encrypted at rest and can be configured per-provider with priority ordering. Org-scoped: provider keys belong to the caller's active organization. Requires org_admin role.

tags.name: Detection & Queries
tags.description: Generate detection rules, hunt queries, and translate queries between SIEM languages. Supports Sigma, KQL (Microsoft Defender/Sentinel), Splunk SPL, YARA, and more. Org-scoped: detection content is generated from org-scoped entity data. Requires Individual plan or higher.

tags.name: Scoring & Pipeline Settings
tags.description: Configure and tune the document scoring engine — thresholds, weights, pipeline settings, content-type boosts, and feedback analysis. Org-scoped: scoring settings apply per organization. Requires org_admin role to modify. Requires Individual plan or higher.

tags.name: Ingestion
tags.description: Control and monitor the CTI ingestion pipeline — trigger runs, re-extract entities, reclassify documents, and ingest URLs on demand. Org-scoped: ingestion operates on sources and documents within the caller's active organization.

tags.name: Relationships
tags.description: Entity relationship graph — connections between threat actors, malware, CVEs, techniques, and IOCs. Org-scoped: relationships are derived from org-scoped entity data.

tags.name: Export
tags.description: Export intelligence data in structured formats for SIEM/SOAR integration. Org-scoped: exports contain only data from the caller's active organization.

tags.name: Intelligence Reports
tags.description: AI-generated intelligence reports — structured threat intelligence reports built from document corpora and entity analysis. Org-scoped: reports belong to the caller's active organization.

tags.name: IOC Triage
tags.description: Analyst-driven IOC (Indicator of Compromise) triage system — vote on indicator verdicts, tag IOCs, and access enriched context. Org-scoped: triage data is isolated per organization.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Document tagging system for organizing and categorizing threat intelligence. Org-scoped: tags belong to the caller's active organization.

tags.name: Audit Log
tags.description: System activity tracking — records all significant actions (document approvals, entity enrichments, configuration changes, ingestion runs). Org-scoped: audit logs are filtered to the caller's active organization. Platform admins can view cross-org logs. Requires org_admin or platform_admin role.

tags.name: API Keys
tags.description: Manage API keys for programmatic/external access with scoped permissions, per-key rate limiting, IP allowlists, and account-level ownership. API keys can be bound to a specific organization, restricting their access scope to that org's data. Requires Individual plan or higher.

tags.name: Patterns & Detection
tags.description: Custom detection patterns, payloads, and attack procedures extracted from intelligence documents. Org-scoped: patterns are extracted from org-scoped documents and entities.

tags.name: Reconciliation
tags.description: Entity reconciliation and deduplication — merges duplicate entities and resolves aliases. Org-scoped: reconciliation operates within the caller's active organization. Requires org_analyst role or higher.

tags.name: Organizations
tags.description: Multi-tenant organization management — create, update, delete organizations, manage members, invitations, email domains, and compliance reports. Organization endpoints enforce role-based access: platform admins can manage all orgs, org admins manage their own org.

tags.name: Organization Profile
tags.description: Organization profile settings including sectors, regions, technologies, threat priorities, watchlists, and contextual intelligence (impact summaries, relevant actors, tech exposure). All profile endpoints are org-scoped to the caller's active organization.

tags.name: TAXII Collections
tags.description: Manage TAXII 2.1 collections for sharing threat intelligence via the TAXII protocol. Collections define what intelligence is shared and how. All TAXII collection endpoints are org-isolated. Requires Team plan or higher.

tags.name: API Documentation
tags.description: Returns the structured API endpoint reference

BearerApiKey.description: API key issued via /api/api-keys. Send as `Authorization: Bearer optx_…`.

ApiKeyQuery.name: api_key
ApiKeyQuery.description: Same key as BearerApiKey, sent as a query parameter for tooling that cannot set headers.

get.description: Returns aggregate counts of documents (total, accepted, quarantined, rejected), entities (by type), sources, ingestion runs, and other metrics. Org-scoped: returns counts only for the caller's active organization. Platform admins with no active org see global totals.

Returns trending entities (by mention velocity), newly emerged entities (first seen in the last 7 days), and landscape shifts (week-over-week changes in entity type distributions). Org-scoped: results are filtered to the caller's active organization. Used by the dashboard for trend analysis.

Returns structured SA data including threat clusters (grouped entities with velocity/momentum metrics), activity pulses (recent notable events), and landscape summary (entity type distribution shifts). Powers the dashboard SA section and the Situational Awareness page.

Returns up to 20 structured threat intelligence cards, each representing a cluster of related activity around a primary entity. Cards include associated actors, malware, CVEs, techniques, IOC counts, source counts, content type breakdown, impact assessment, and document references. Supports a 'range' query parameter (7d, 14d, 30d, 90d, all) to control the time window.
Returns aggregate statistics about analyst feedback on document scoring — total feedback count, approval/rejection rates, average score adjustments, and per-reason breakdowns.

Returns all configured intelligence sources with their settings, poll frequencies, enabled status, and last poll timestamps. Org-isolated: returns only sources belonging to the caller's active organization.

post.description: Registers a new threat intelligence source. The source will be polled at the configured frequency during ingestion runs.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the source

type.description: Source type: rss, api, crawler, social

url.description: Feed URL, API endpoint, or base URL to crawl

enabled.description: Whether the source is active for polling (default: true)

pollFrequency.description: How often to poll: hourly, daily, weekly (default: daily)

scoringOverrides.description: Per-source scoring weight overrides (e.g., { "cve": 2.0 } to double CVE weight for this source)

patch.description: Modify any source field — name, URL, type, poll frequency, enabled status, or scoring overrides.

delete.description: Permanently removes a source. Existing documents from this source are preserved.

post.description: Toggle the enabled status of multiple sources at once. Disabled sources are skipped during ingestion runs.

ids.description: Array of source IDs to update

enabled.description: Set to true to enable, false to disable

post.description: Permanently removes multiple sources. Existing documents are preserved.

ids.description: Array of source IDs to delete

get.summary: Get documents from a specific source
get.description: Returns all documents ingested from this source, ordered by ingestion date.

post.description: Bulk import sources from a JSON array. Skips duplicates by URL. Useful for migrating configurations between OPTIX instances.

sources.description: Array of source objects with name, type, url, and optional settings

get.description: Returns all sources in a portable JSON format for backup or migration to another OPTIX instance.
Returns document counts, acceptance rates, average scores, and last poll timestamps for each source. Useful for identifying high-quality and low-quality feeds.

Analyzes overlap between configured sources by comparing document content and entity coverage. Identifies redundant sources that cover the same threat actors, malware families, or CVEs. Returns overlap scores and shared entity counts between source pairs.

Comprehensive coverage analysis showing which entity types (threat actors, malware, CVEs, techniques) are covered by which sources, identifying gaps in coverage. Returns per-type breakdowns, source contribution metrics, and recommendations for filling coverage gaps.
Returns auto-discovered source candidates. Filter by status to see pending, approved, or dismissed sources.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: pending, approved, dismissed (default: all)

post.description: Manually add a discovered source candidate to the pipeline. Used when adding sources from catalog web search results or other external discovery mechanisms.

title.description: Title or name of the source

get.summary: Get a discovered source by ID
get.description: Returns details for a single discovered source including the referencing document and extraction context.

post.description: Converts a discovered source into an active source and begins ingesting from it on the next run.
Marks a discovered source as dismissed so it won't be suggested again.
Dismiss multiple discovered sources at once.

ids.description: Array of discovered source IDs to dismiss

post.description: Approve multiple discovered sources at once. Each approved source is automatically added to the ingestion pipeline as a configured source. Skips sources that are already configured (deduplication by URL).

ids.description: Array of discovered source IDs to approve

get.description: Searches for cybersecurity-relevant social media channels across Reddit, Discord, Telegram, and Mastodon. Returns channel recommendations with relevance scoring.

parameters.name: platforms
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of platforms to search: reddit, discord, telegram, mastodon (default: all)

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Comma-separated custom search keywords (default: built-in CTI keyword set)

post.summary: Preview a source URL before adding
post.description: Fetches and analyzes a URL to determine its suitability as a CTI source. Detects RSS/Atom feeds, validates content relevance, checks for overlap with existing sources, and returns a preview with sample articles, detected feed type, and confidence assessment.

get.description: Returns the curated catalog of known CTI sources (RSS feeds, APIs, blogs). Supports filtering by category and type, and text search across names, descriptions, and tags. Each entry includes whether it's already configured in your instance.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search across name, description, tags, and category

get.summary: Get catalog recommendations based on coverage gaps
get.description: Analyzes your current source configuration and entity coverage to recommend catalog sources that would fill gaps. Prioritizes categories with low entity counts (e.g., recommends APT sources if few threat actors are tracked). Returns scored recommendations sorted by relevance.

post.summary: Search the web for CTI sources
post.description: Performs a DuckDuckGo web search for CTI sources matching the query. Applies listicle/aggregator filtering, RSS feed detection, and confidence scoring to each result. Returns structured recommendations that can be added to the discovery pipeline. Distinct from catalog entries — these are web-discovered recommendations.

query.description: Search query for finding CTI sources (e.g., 'ICS security blog', 'ransomware threat intel feed')

post.description: Add multiple sources from the curated catalog to the ingestion pipeline at once. Each source is created as a configured source with the catalog-specified type and settings.

sources.description: Array of catalog source objects to add, each with name, url, type, category fields

get.description: Returns accepted (classified) documents with pagination. Supports search by title/content and filtering by content type or source. Documents are ordered by ingestion date (newest first). Org-scoped: returns documents belonging to the caller's active organization, plus documents shared via document_organizations.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset for paging through results

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search across document title and content

get.description: Returns document counts grouped by date for timeline/histogram visualization. Shows ingestion volume over time.
Returns documents in quarantine awaiting analyst review. These scored between the reject and accept thresholds.
Returns documents that scored below the reject threshold. Rejected documents are auto-purged after 7 days unless restored.

Returns documents that have been flagged by analysts as misleading or problematic. Flagged documents have their entities removed and are excluded from analysis. Each document includes entity counts, content preview, flag reason, and flagged timestamp.

Returns full document details including title, content, score, classification, source info, detection content, and metadata. The :id segment accepts a numeric document ID, a document title, or a slug. When resolved from a title or slug, the response includes a resolved_from field.

get.summary: Get score breakdown for a document
get.description: Re-runs the scoring algorithm and returns an itemized breakdown of every factor's contribution (CVE mentions, IOC density, keyword matches, actor references, code snippets, tradecraft, etc.) with their weights.

post.description: Simulates rescoring a document with modified thresholds and weights without saving. Returns the hypothetical classification decision — useful for tuning scoring parameters before applying them.

get.summary: Get entities extracted from a document
get.description: Returns all entities (threat actors, malware, CVEs, IOCs, techniques) that were extracted from this document, with confidence scores and extraction metadata.

get.summary: Get evidence spans for a document
get.description: Returns the source text snippets that back each extracted entity — the exact passages in the document where entities were identified. Essential for provenance and analyst verification. The :id segment accepts a numeric document ID, title, or slug. When resolved from a name, the response includes a resolved_from field.

Returns up to 10 documents related to this document, ranked by entity co-occurrence and content similarity. The :id segment accepts a numeric document ID, title, or slug. When resolved from a name, the response includes a resolved_from field.

post.description: Self-publish a WorkbenchResearch document created in the analyst's personal scope to the shared feed. Only the document's creator can publish it. The :id segment accepts a numeric document ID, title, or slug. When resolved from a name, the response includes a resolved_from field.

sharingScope.description: Sharing scope for the published document (default: org)

get.summary: Get detection brief for a document
get.description: Returns structured detection metadata extracted from the document: MITRE ATT&CK techniques, IOCs, execution chains, tradecraft, persistence mechanisms, lateral movement patterns, code snippets, attack methods, attack surfaces, and defensive guidance.

post.summary: Generate AI summary for a document
post.description: Uses LLM to generate a concise 2-4 sentence threat intelligence brief summarizing the document's key findings, actors, techniques, and indicators. The :id segment accepts a numeric document ID, title, or slug. When resolved from a name, the response includes a resolved_from field.
Accepts a quarantined or rejected document into the main corpus. Triggers entity extraction and records analyst feedback for scoring tuning.

reason.description: Analyst's reason for approval (logged for scoring feedback)

post.description: Rejects a quarantined document and records analyst feedback. Rejected documents auto-purge after 7 days.

reason.description: Analyst's reason for rejection (logged for scoring feedback)

post.description: Flags a document as misleading or problematic. Removes all extracted entities from the document and records the flag reason. The document is excluded from entity analysis until unflagged. Requires a reason string (min 2 characters).

reason.description: Reason for flagging (e.g., 'Contains fabricated IOCs', 'Misleading attribution')

post.description: Removes the misleading flag from a document and re-runs entity extraction if the document was previously accepted. Restores the document to normal analysis workflow.
Flag multiple documents at once. Each document has its entities removed and is marked as misleading. Maximum 50 documents per request.

ids.description: Array of document IDs to flag (max 50)

reason.description: Reason for flagging all selected documents

post.description: Remove the misleading flag from multiple documents at once. Re-runs entity extraction for previously accepted documents. Maximum 50 documents per request.

ids.description: Array of document IDs to unflag (max 50)

post.description: Approve multiple quarantined/rejected documents at once. Entity extraction runs for each approved document.

ids.description: Array of document IDs to approve

post.description: Reject multiple quarantined documents at once.

ids.description: Array of document IDs to reject

post.description: Moves a rejected document back to quarantine for re-review. Pass ?action=approve to approve directly instead of quarantining.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Set to 'approve' to accept directly instead of moving to quarantine

post.description: Permanently removes a rejected document without waiting for the 7-day auto-purge.
Permanently remove multiple rejected documents at once.

ids.description: Array of document IDs to dismiss

post.description: Re-runs the full CTI extraction pipeline (entity extraction, detection content analysis, relationship discovery) on an existing document. Useful after extraction improvements or when initial extraction was incomplete.
Manually submit a threat intelligence document (article, advisory, report) with title, content, and optional metadata. The document goes through scoring, classification, and entity extraction.
Upload a document file (PDF, text, HTML) via multipart form data. The file is parsed, scored, classified, and entity-extracted.

get.description: Returns all extracted entities with optional type and name search filters. Each entity includes its type, name, aliases, confidence score, description, linked document count, version number, content checksum, and updatedAt timestamp. Supports conditional requests via If-Modified-Since header (returns 304 if no entities changed). Use the updated_since parameter for efficient incremental sync — only entities modified after the given timestamp are returned.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by entity type: ThreatActor, MalwareFamily, Vulnerability, IOC, Technique, Tool

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search entities by name or alias (case-insensitive)

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — only return entities modified after this time (e.g., 2025-03-15T00:00:00Z). Enables efficient incremental sync for SIEM/TIP integrations.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entities to return

get.description: Returns full entity details including description, aliases, confidence score, metadata, linked documents with dates, relationships to other entities, evidence spans, and enrichment data. Includes version number, contentChecksum, and updatedAt for change tracking. Response includes ETag (from content checksum) and Last-Modified headers. Supports conditional requests via If-None-Match header — send the ETag value to get 304 Not Modified if the entity hasn't changed. The :id segment accepts a numeric entity ID, an entity name (e.g. 'APT29'), or a known alias. When resolved from a name, the response includes a resolved_from field indicating the lookup method and matched term.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Entity ID (numeric), name, or alias (e.g. 'APT29', 'Cozy Bear')

post.summary: Enrich entity from its linked documents
post.description: Uses AI to extract additional context (description, severity, affected products) from the entity's source documents. Primarily useful for CVE/Vulnerability entities that need richer descriptions.

get.summary: Get aggregated detection content for an entity
get.description: Aggregates detection-relevant content across all documents linked to this entity: execution chains, tradecraft, persistence mechanisms, lateral movement, infrastructure, code snippets, detection rules (Sigma/YARA/custom), hunt queries, defensive guidance, attack methods, attack surfaces, and detection opportunities. De-duplicated across documents. For technique entities, also returns associated actors and malware. Includes AI-generated detection rules, hunt queries, and behavioral detections from entity metadata. The :id segment accepts a numeric entity ID, entity name, or alias. When resolved from a name, the response includes a resolved_from field.

Returns up to 20 entities most similar to this one based on shared TTPs, sectors, and infrastructure overlap. Similarity scores are computed and cached. The :id segment accepts a numeric entity ID, name, or alias. When resolved from a name, the response includes a resolved_from field.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max similar entities to return (default 10, max 20)

get.description: Exports an entity and its relationships as a STIX 2.1 bundle (application/stix+json). The :id segment accepts a numeric entity ID, name, or alias. When resolved from a name, the X-Resolved-From response header is set.

post.summary: Export entity as deployable YAML artifacts
post.description: Generates deployment-ready YAML artifacts (Sigma rules, YARA rules, KQL/SPL queries) for an entity. The :id segment accepts a numeric entity ID, name, or alias. When resolved from a name, the response includes a resolved_from field.

post.summary: Generate detection coverage for an entity
post.description: Uses AI to generate comprehensive detection coverage: Sigma rules, KQL/Splunk hunt queries, YARA rules, behavioral detections, log source requirements, and observable fields. Coverage is stored in entity metadata and can be edited via the coverage-item endpoint. Only available for ThreatActor, MalwareFamily, Tool, and Vulnerability entity types.

patch.summary: Update a specific detection coverage item
patch.description: Updates a single detection coverage item (procedure, detection rule, hunt query, log source, observable field, or behavioral detection) within an entity's generated coverage. Allows analysts to refine AI-generated content.

criterion.description: Coverage criterion type: procedures, detection_rules, hunt_queries, log_sources, observable_fields, behavioral_detection, behavioral_detection_context, behavioral_detection_query

index.description: Index of the item within the criterion array to update

data.description: Updated data for the coverage item

delete.summary: Delete a specific detection coverage item
delete.description: Removes a single detection coverage item from an entity's generated coverage.

criterion.description: Coverage criterion type to delete from

index.description: Index of the item to remove

get.summary: Get detection coverage report for an entity
get.description: Generates a comprehensive detection coverage report for an entity, including related entities (techniques, IOCs, malware), linked documents, detection rules, hunt queries, behavioral detections, and coverage scoring. Only available for ThreatActor, MalwareFamily, Tool, and Vulnerability types.

get.summary: Download detection package for an entity
get.description: Returns a structured detection package containing all detection rules (Sigma, YARA), hunt queries (KQL, Splunk SPL), IOC lists, behavioral detections, and coverage metadata for an entity. Designed for export to SIEM/SOAR platforms. Only available for ThreatActor, MalwareFamily, Tool, and Vulnerability types.

post.summary: Run deep research on an entity
post.description: Performs comprehensive AI-driven research on a threat entity using all available document context and enrichment data. Streams results via Server-Sent Events (SSE) with progress updates. Generates detailed intelligence reports covering TTPs, infrastructure, campaigns, and relationships. Available for ThreatActor, MalwareFamily, Vulnerability, Tool, Campaign, and Technique entity types. The :id segment accepts a numeric entity ID, name, or alias. When resolved from a name, all response objects include a resolved_from field.

get.summary: Get stored research results for an entity
get.description: Returns previously generated deep research results for an entity, if any exist.

post.summary: Query threat intelligence providers for an entity
post.description: Queries configured utility providers (VirusTotal, OTX, URLhaus, MalwareBazaar, ThreatFox, GreyNoise, AbuseIPDB, URLScan) for enrichment data on an entity. Returns detection artifacts (YARA rules, Sigma rules, IOCs, hunt queries), threat context, and materialization stats. Results are cached for 24 hours. IOCs discovered during enrichment are materialized as entity records and linked via relationships.

providers.description: Specific provider names to query (default: all applicable providers)

forceRefresh.description: Set to true to bypass the 24-hour cache and re-query providers

get.summary: Get threat assessment for an entity
get.description: Returns a structured threat assessment for an entity including severity scoring, activity timeline, related entities, and contextual intelligence.

post.summary: Generate an intelligence report for an entity
post.description: Uses AI to generate a detailed intelligence report for a threat entity covering TTPs, infrastructure, campaigns, and recommendations.

get.summary: Get a previously generated intelligence report
get.description: Returns a stored AI-generated intelligence report for an entity, if one exists.

post.description: Performs a comprehensive search across documents and entities. Supports multiple search modes: 'keyword' for direct text matching, 'natural' for AI-expanded natural language queries (expands query into primary and secondary search terms), and 'semantic' for meaning-based search. Returns scored results with snippets, entity matches, and source metadata.

mode.description: Search mode: keyword, natural, semantic (default: keyword)

filters.description: Optional filters: { types: string[], dateRange: { from, to }, sourceIds: number[] }

post.summary: Enhance search results with AI analysis
post.description: Takes a search query and a set of document results, then uses AI to generate an analytical summary synthesizing findings across the documents. Provides strategic context, identifies patterns, and highlights key takeaways. Returns a structured intelligence brief with key findings, affected sectors, recommended actions, and related entities.

documents.description: Array of document objects (with id fields) from search results to analyze

post.description: Performs a comprehensive multi-step AI research process via Server-Sent Events (SSE). Steps include: query intent classification, database search, entity correlation, gap analysis, follow-up searches, and final synthesis. Streams progress events with step updates, intermediate results, and a final comprehensive research report. Suitable for complex research questions that require cross-referencing multiple data sources.
Queries VirusTotal for file, IP, domain, or URL intelligence. Returns detection rates, analysis results, and threat classifications. Requires Individual plan.

indicator.description: The IOC to look up (IP, domain, hash, URL)

type.description: Indicator type hint: ip, domain, hash, url (auto-detected if omitted)

post.description: Queries AbuseIPDB for IP reputation data including abuse confidence score, report count, and categories. Requires Individual plan.
Queries Shodan for IP intelligence including open ports, services, vulnerabilities, and hosting information. Requires Individual plan.
Queries GreyNoise to determine if an IP is associated with internet scanning activity (noise) or known benign services (RIOT). Requires Individual plan.
Queries URLScan.io for scan results on a URL or domain, including maliciousness verdict, page content analysis, and redirects. Requires Individual plan.
Queries Abuse.ch URLhaus for known malware distribution URLs, payloads, and threat tags. No API key required.

indicator.description: URL, domain, IP, or hash to check

post.summary: Enrich an indicator via AlienVault OTX
post.description: Queries AlienVault OTX for pulse data, related indicators, and threat context on IPs, domains, URLs, and file hashes. Requires Individual plan.

post.summary: Enrich an IP via CrowdSec CTI
post.description: Queries CrowdSec for IP reputation based on crowd-sourced threat intelligence and behavioral analysis. Requires Individual plan.
Queries ip-api.com for geolocation data including country, city, ISP, and AS information. No API key required (rate limited to 45/min).

post.summary: Enrich an entity across all applicable providers
post.description: Automatically queries all relevant enrichment providers for an entity based on its type. For example, an IP entity queries VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, Shodan, GreyNoise, and geolocation. Results are merged and stored. Requires Individual plan.

get.description: Returns current rate limit and daily quota usage for all enrichment providers. Shows remaining capacity and reset times. Requires Individual plan.

Returns all configured provider API keys with metadata: provider name, label, key preview (masked), enabled status, priority, last used timestamp, and status. Encrypted keys are never exposed. Requires org_admin role.

post.description: Decrypts and tests a stored provider API key by making a lightweight validation request to the provider's API. Returns success/failure status. Requires org_admin role.

get.description: Returns all configured API sources classified as 'utility' or 'both' (feed + utility). Shows each provider's name, classification, enabled status, whether an API key is available, and which entity types it supports. Used to populate the utility query provider selection UI.
Returns metadata about all known enrichment providers including supported indicator types, rate limits, and whether keys are configured.
Returns all supported SIEM/detection query language references with syntax examples and documentation links.

post.summary: Generate a detection query from a technique
post.description: Uses AI to generate a detection query for a specific MITRE ATT&CK technique in the specified SIEM language. Returns the query, description, data sources, and false positive guidance. Requires Individual plan.

technique.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID or name (e.g., 'T1059.001')

language.description: Target SIEM language: KQL, Splunk SPL, Sigma, YARA, etc.

context.description: Additional context for more targeted query generation

post.description: Generates a detection query targeting specific IOCs (hashes, IPs, domains, URLs) in the specified SIEM language. Requires Individual plan.

iocs.description: Array of IOCs with type and value fields

post.summary: Translate a query between SIEM languages
post.description: Translates a detection/hunt query from one SIEM language to another using AI. Preserves detection logic while adapting syntax. Requires Individual plan.

get.description: Returns the current scoring configuration including accept/reject thresholds, per-factor weights, content type boosts, and source-specific overrides.

Returns the active pipeline settings including roundup detection patterns, espionage patterns, source multipliers, max contributions caps, crawler minimum content length, cyber keywords list, malware analysis keywords, benign IP/domain lists, entity database stats, and default values for all settings. Hard-rescue thresholds live on the scoring config (hardRescueSemanticMin / hardRescueQualityMin), not here.

post.description: Simulates the impact of proposed scoring configuration changes on all existing documents without applying them. Returns how many documents would be reclassified (accepted, quarantined, rejected).

get.description: Returns the analyst feedback log — all approve/reject decisions with reasons. Used for auditing and scoring tuning analysis.
Aggregate analysis of analyst feedback patterns to identify systematic scoring errors — e.g., consistently approving documents the engine rejected, suggesting threshold adjustment.
Breakdown of why documents were rejected by the scoring engine. Identifies which factors most commonly cause rejections.
Returns scoring quality metrics for each configured source: acceptance rate, average score, score distribution, and trend data. Helps identify low-quality feeds.

get.summary: Get example documents for a source's scoring
get.description: Returns sample documents from a specific source showing their scores and classifications. Useful for understanding why a source has a particular quality rating.

get.summary: Get scoring diagnostics for a source
get.description: Detailed scoring diagnostics for a specific source — score breakdowns, factor distributions, and recommendations for scoring override adjustments.
Returns a histogram of document scores across the entire database, showing the distribution of scores and where accept/reject thresholds fall.
Returns current ingestion state: whether a run is active, progress details (documents processed/total), current source being polled, and queue depth.
Returns history of ingestion runs with their start/end times, status (completed, failed, in_progress), document counts (new, updated, skipped), and error details.

get.summary: Get per-source logs for an ingestion run
get.description: Returns detailed per-source breakdown for a specific run: documents fetched, accepted, rejected, errors, and timing for each source.
Returns progress of a background re-extraction run: documents processed, remaining, and any errors encountered.
Returns progress of a background reclassification run.

post.summary: Extract and ingest content from a URL
post.description: Fetches a URL, extracts its content (article text, metadata), runs CTI analysis (scoring, entity extraction, detection content), and ingests it as a new document. Useful for ad-hoc intelligence ingestion.

url.description: Full URL to fetch and process (e.g., 'https://blog.example.com/apt-analysis')

get.description: Returns the history of URLs that have been manually extracted and ingested, with their processing results.
Returns relationships between entities with optional filtering by entity ID, relationship type, or entity type. Each relationship includes subject, object, type, confidence, and source document.
Exports entities in a structured format suitable for SIEM/SOAR ingestion. Supports filtering by type.

Exports all IOCs associated with a specific entity, including those discovered through enrichment. Suitable for blocklist generation. The :id segment accepts a numeric entity ID, name, or alias. When resolved from a name, the X-Resolved-From response header is set with resolution metadata.
Returns all intelligence reports for the organization, ordered by creation date (newest first).

Returns a single intelligence report including its full content, status, and metadata. The :id segment accepts a numeric report ID or the report title. When resolved from a title, the response includes a resolved_from field indicating the lookup method and matched title.

Returns the current generation status of a report (pending, running, completed, failed) with step-by-step progress details and queue position. The :id segment accepts a numeric report ID or title. When resolved from a title, the response includes a resolved_from field.

Exports the intelligence report as a formatted PDF file. Returns binary PDF data with Content-Disposition: attachment. The :id segment accepts a numeric report ID or title. When resolved from a title, the X-Resolved-From response header is set with resolution metadata.
Returns IOC entities with their current triage status (benign, malicious, suspicious, unknown), vote tallies, and analyst reputation metadata.

get.summary: Get enriched context for an IOC
get.description: Returns comprehensive enrichment context for an IOC: vote history, tally, tags, entity associations, source documents, related IOCs, threat context (associated actors, malware, tools, campaigns, techniques), and geo/ASN metadata for IP-type indicators. The :id segment accepts a numeric entity ID or the raw indicator value (e.g. an IP address, domain, or hash). When resolved from a raw value, the response includes a resolved_from field.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: IOC entity ID (numeric) or raw indicator value (IP, domain, hash, URL, email)

get.summary: Get vote history for an IOC
get.description: Returns all analyst votes for an IOC with sanitized analyst reputation tiers, plus the current vote tally. The :id segment accepts a numeric entity ID or raw indicator value. When resolved from a raw value, the response includes a resolved_from field.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: IOC entity ID (numeric) or raw indicator value

post.summary: Submit a vote on an IOC
post.description: Submit an analyst verdict vote (malicious, benign, suspicious) on an IOC. Votes are weighted by analyst reputation tier. A note can be added for context.

note.description: Optional analyst note explaining the verdict

post.summary: Add a tag to an IOC
post.description: Adds a categorized tag to an IOC for organizing and filtering during triage. The :id segment accepts a numeric entity ID or raw indicator value. When resolved from a raw value, the response includes a resolved_from field.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: IOC entity ID (numeric) or raw indicator value

get.description: Returns all tags with their usage counts.

post.description: Creates new tags and/or applies existing tags to documents or entities.

tags.description: Tag names to create or apply

delete.description: Removes a tag and all its associations.

get.description: Returns usage statistics for all tags including document and entity counts.

Returns the system activity log. Each entry records who did what, when, and any associated metadata. Useful for compliance, debugging, and tracking analyst activity. Requires org_admin or platform_admin role.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset for paging through history

get.description: Returns all API keys with metadata: name, permissions, rate limit, enabled status, creation date, last used, usage count, owner (userId), and IP allowlist. Key hashes are never exposed.

post.description: Generates a new API key (optx_... prefix) with specified permissions. The key is automatically bound to the authenticated user's account. The raw key is returned ONLY in this response — store it securely. Authenticate with the 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' header. Optionally restrict access to specific IP addresses or CIDR ranges.

name.description: Descriptive name for the key (e.g., 'SIEM Integration', 'SOAR Playbook')

permissions.description: Permission scopes: read:documents, read:entities, read:sources, read:stats, read:reports, read:threat-cards, read:tags, write:documents, write:sources, write:tags, search, enrichment, detection, reports, correlation, export, ingestion, admin

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 expiration date, or null for no expiry

ipAllowlist.description: Restrict key usage to specific IPs or CIDR ranges (e.g., ['10.0.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24']). Leave empty for unrestricted access.

get.description: Returns all permission scopes with descriptions. Available scopes: read:documents, read:entities, read:sources, read:stats, read:reports, read:threat-cards, read:tags, write:documents, write:sources, write:tags, search, enrichment, detection, reports, correlation, export, ingestion, admin.

patch.description: Modify a key's name, permissions, rate limit, enabled status, expiration, or IP allowlist. The key value itself is not changed — use regenerate for that.

ipAllowlist.description: Updated IP allowlist, or null to remove restriction

delete.description: Permanently revokes and deletes an API key. All requests using this key will immediately fail. This action cannot be undone.

post.description: Invalidates the current key and generates a new one with the same permissions. The new raw key is returned ONLY in this response. Old key stops working immediately.

get.description: Returns all custom detection patterns (Sigma rules, YARA rules, Snort rules, custom queries) created by analysts or generated from entity analysis.

post.description: Create a new custom detection pattern with rule content, type, and optional entity associations.

type.description: Pattern type: sigma, yara, snort, custom

patch.description: Modify an existing detection pattern's name, content, type, or entity association.

get.description: Returns payloads (code samples, shell commands, exploit code, configuration snippets) extracted from ingested documents during entity extraction.
Returns MITRE ATT&CK procedure examples extracted from documents — specific instances of techniques used by threat actors, including command lines, artifacts, and source document references.
Returns the current status of entity reconciliation — whether it is running, last run timestamp, and statistics from the most recent run (entities processed, duplicates merged, aliases resolved).

Returns organizations visible to the caller. Platform admins see all organizations with member counts, admin names, document counts, and source counts. Regular users see only organizations they belong to, with their role in each.

post.description: Creates a new organization. Platform-admin only. The slug is auto-generated from the name if not provided. Returns 409 if the slug already exists.

slug.description: URL-safe slug (auto-generated from name if omitted)

get.description: Returns full organization details including member count. Org-scoped: non-admin users can only access organizations they belong to.

put.description: Updates organization fields (name, description, sectors, regions, technologies, etc.). Requires org_admin role for the target org or platform_admin. Only platform admins can change the enabled status.

get.description: Returns a comprehensive overview of an organization including members, recent documents, sources, document/entity counts, and profile summary. Platform-admin only.
Returns all members of an organization with their roles, names, and email addresses. Accessible to org members and platform admins.

post.summary: Add a member to an organization
post.description: Adds a user to an organization by email or userId. If the user doesn't exist and sendInvite is true, sends an invitation email. Requires org_admin or platform_admin. Returns 409 if already a member.

email.description: User's email address (creates invitation if user doesn't exist)

userId.description: Existing user ID to add directly

role.description: Role: org_viewer, org_analyst, or org_admin (default: org_viewer)

sendInvite.description: Send invitation email if user doesn't exist (default: true)

patch.description: Changes a member's role within the organization. Requires org_admin or platform_admin.

role.description: New role: org_viewer, org_analyst, or org_admin

delete.summary: Remove a member from an organization
delete.description: Removes a user from the organization. Requires org_admin or platform_admin. Org admins cannot remove themselves (use the leave endpoint instead).

post.description: Allows the authenticated user to leave an organization. Fails if the user is the only admin — they must transfer the admin role first.

post.summary: Send password reset to a member
post.description: Sends a password reset email to an organization member. Requires org_admin or platform_admin. The reset link expires in 1 hour.

patch.description: Toggles a member's active status. Deactivated users cannot log in. Cannot deactivate org admins or yourself. Requires org_admin or platform_admin.

isActive.description: Set true to activate, false to deactivate

get.summary: List email domains for an organization
get.description: Returns the list of verified email domains for auto-assignment of new users to this organization. Requires org_admin or platform_admin.

post.description: Adds a verified email domain to the organization. Users registering with this email domain can be auto-assigned to the organization. Requires org_admin or platform_admin.

delete.description: Removes a verified email domain from the organization. Requires org_admin or platform_admin.

get.description: Returns all pending and accepted invitations for the organization. Requires org_admin, org_analyst, or platform_admin.

post.description: Resends an invitation email and extends the expiry by 7 days. Requires org_admin or platform_admin.

delete.description: Deletes a pending invitation so it can no longer be used. Requires org_admin or platform_admin.

get.description: Generates a compliance/audit report for an organization including member activity, action breakdowns, and audit log analysis. Supports date range filtering. Requires org_admin or platform_admin.

Returns the full organization profile including name, description, sectors, operating/monitoring regions, technologies, critical assets, org size, threat priorities, compliance frameworks, key contacts, detection platforms, and watchlists. Org-scoped: returns the profile for the caller's active organization.

put.description: Updates the organization profile with validated sectors, regions, technologies, and threat priorities. Sectors must match the OPTIX sector taxonomy. Requires org_admin or platform_admin. Org-scoped: updates the caller's active organization profile.

sectors.description: Industry sectors (must be from OPTIX taxonomy)

monitoringRegions.description: Regions the org monitors for threats

orgSize.description: Organization size: Small (1-50), Medium (51-500), Large (501-5000), Enterprise (5000+)

threatPriorities.description: Priority threat types (e.g., Ransomware, Espionage / APT)

get.description: Returns the user's org filter opt-out preference and whether they have an active org membership. Org-scoped.

patch.description: Toggles the organization filter opt-out preference for the current user. When opted out, data views show all accessible data instead of org-filtered results.

orgFilterOptOut.description: Set true to opt out of org filtering

get.description: Returns the lists of valid options for sectors, regions, threat priorities, and org sizes that can be used when configuring the organization profile. No org-scoping: returns platform-wide taxonomies.

Computes a real-time impact summary for the organization based on its profile — counts of relevant threat actors, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, coverage gaps, high-relevance threat cards, tech exposure entities, critical asset matches, and watchlist hits. Org-scoped: analysis uses the caller's active organization profile.

Returns threat actors that match the organization's profile — actors targeting the org's sectors, operating regions, or monitoring regions. Includes match reasons for each actor. Org-scoped: uses the caller's active organization profile. Returns up to 30 actors sorted by relevance.

example.name: APT29
matchReasons: Targets your operating region: Western Europe

get.description: Returns the top 5 threat cards most relevant to the organization's profile, filtered by relevance score > 50. Each card includes relevance score, relevance reasons, and key metrics. Org-scoped.
Analyzes the organization's technology stack against extracted threat intelligence to identify entities (malware, vulnerabilities, tools) that mention or target the org's technologies. Org-scoped.

Returns all TAXII collections for the caller's organization. Each collection includes its title, description, entity type filters, access key status, and sharing configuration. Requires analyst or admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.

post.description: Creates a new TAXII collection with a unique collection ID. Configure entity type filters, title, description, and other settings. The collection is automatically bound to the caller's active organization. Available on Team plan and above.

entityTypes.description: Entity types to include (e.g., ThreatActor, MalwareFamily, IOC)

patch.description: Updates a TAXII collection's title, description, entity type filters, or other settings. Org-isolated: can only update collections belonging to the caller's organization. Available on Team plan and above.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a TAXII collection and revokes all associated API keys. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.

post.description: Regenerates the API key for a TAXII collection. The old key is immediately invalidated. Requires admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.

get.description: Returns analytics for a TAXII collection including entity counts by type, access statistics, and recent activity. Requires analyst or admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.

Returns entities that are pinned (explicitly included) in a TAXII collection. Pinned entities are always included regardless of dynamic filters. Requires analyst or admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.

put.description: Replaces all pinned entities in a TAXII collection with the provided list. Requires admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.

entityIds.description: Array of entity IDs to pin

post.description: Adds a single entity to the pinned entities list of a TAXII collection. Requires admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.

delete.description: Removes a single entity from the pinned entities list. Requires admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.

get.description: Returns a summary of the content available in a TAXII collection — entity counts by type, total objects, and last updated timestamp. Requires analyst or admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.

Returns a preview of the STIX objects that would be included in the TAXII collection based on current filters and pinned entities. Requires analyst or admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.
Returns all API keys associated with a TAXII collection. Requires admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.

post.description: Creates a new API key for accessing a TAXII collection via the TAXII 2.1 protocol. Requires admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.

get.description: Returns the access log for a TAXII collection showing who accessed it and when. Requires analyst or admin role. Org-isolated. Available on Team plan and above.
Returns the structured JSON documentation for all API endpoints organized by category. Used by the /api-docs frontend page.
